data.one_liner: A customizable dropdown widget supporting single/multiple selection and integrated search.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable dropdown widget displayed in a bottom sheet. It supports both single and multiple selection, type-safe custom data handling through generics, and integrated search functionality.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet dropdown that supports single or multiple selection.
You require built-in search capabilities inside your selection list.
You want to handle custom data types in a type-safe manner.
avoid_when: You need an inline dropdown button instead of a bottom sheet modal.
You require complex form field integration with built-in form validation controllers out of the box.
strengths: Supports both single and multiple selection modes
Type-safe generic support for custom data
Highly customizable UI appearance and bottom sheet behavior
weaknesses: Presented exclusively as a bottom sheet modal via `DropDownState`
Limited to specific pre-defined UI parameters and callbacks
